div.head: Cn 1020 11
div.ab: ⁊ eac ic beode eallum minum gerefum, be minum freondscype ⁊ be eallum þam þe hi agon ⁊ be heora agenum life, þæt hy æghwær min folc rihtlice healdan ⁊ rihte domas deman be ðære scira biscopa gewitnesse, ⁊ swylce mildheortnesse þæron don swylce þære scire biscope riht þince ⁊ se man acuman mæge.

And likewise I enjoin upon all my reeves, under pain of forfeiting my friendship and all that they possess and their own lives, to govern my people justly everywhere, and to pronounce just judgments with the cognisance of the bishops of the dioceses, and to inflict such mitigated penalties as the bishop may approve and the man himself may be able to bear.

Und ferner allen meinen Vögten gebiet ich, bei meiner Freundschaft und bei all dem was sie besitzen und bei ihrem eigenen Leben, dass sie überall mein Volk gesetzmässig regiren und gerechte Urtheile fällen unter Mitwissen der Diöcesanbischöfe und dabei solche Milde üben, welche dem Diöcesanbischof recht dünkt und die man [der Staat] ertragen kann.

And further I command all my reeves, on [pain of losing] my friendship and all that they own and their own lives, that they govern my people justly everywhere and give just judgments with the witness of the diocesan bishops, and show such mercy in them as seems right to the diocesan bishop and as can be borne.
